rows.requirement: Read the v1.1 canonical-point output only after exact blob, 92283-feature parse, full-stream hash, unique target occurrence and finite Point gates pass.
Interpret accepted GeoJSON coordinates as longitude then latitude under RFC 7946; reject axis swapping.
Record that RFC 7946 supplies WGS84 coordinate semantics but the historical blob does not contain independent survey CRS lineage.
Record the WGS84-to-ETRS89 epoch decision or classify the epoch as unknown; do not silently equate dynamic WGS84 with ETRS89 for parcel-grade claims.
Record pyproj, PROJ database and PROJ runtime versions before transformation.
Build a TransformerGroup with always_xy and allow_ballpark=false; preserve best_available and unavailable_operations.
Require the best known transformation and fail if a required grid is missing or the selected operation is not available.
Record the selected operation name, method, authority codes and grid names and require OSTN15-compatible evidence for EPSG:27700 output.
Reject ballpark and approximate Helmert operations, including any path with published multi-metre uncertainty.
Require finite easting and northing inside the EPSG:27700 area of use and preserve full precision before display rounding.
Fetch layer 0 and layer 1 metadata with f=json and require the expected names, geometry type Polygon and EPSG:27700 spatial reference.
Read the objectIdField from live layer metadata instead of assuming objectid casing.
Read live maxRecordCount and query capabilities before selecting batch size.
Issue returnIdsOnly=true intersects queries for each EPSG:27700 point against DTM layer 0 and DSM layer 1.
Use HTTPS POST form encoding for query parameters and retain canonical request parameter JSON without credentials.
Require HTTP success, JSON-compatible content type and a bounded response size; reject HTML error pages.
Reject any JSON response containing an ArcGIS error object and preserve code, message and details.
Require integer unique object IDs, sort them deterministically and publish the complete ID list hash.
Retrieve outFields=* and geometry for deterministic object-ID batches no larger than live maxRecordCount.
Reconcile returned feature object IDs exactly to the requested set; reject missing, duplicate or unexpected features.
Store every raw metadata, ID and feature response with SHA256, request timestamp and source URL.
Require the live fields needed by the Batch 8 schema contract and copy attribute names verbatim.
Rank DTM candidates by accepted transform/geoid, metadata completeness, native resolution, latest marker and survey date; preserve rejected rows and reasons.
Pair DSM only when survey/date, tile or coverage, resolution, transform and geoid are consistent with the selected DTM.
Resolve the official 5 km tile or survey download identity from selected catalogue attributes without guessing a URL.
Hash the downloaded archive and every extracted GeoTIFF; reject path traversal, duplicate names and unexpected file types.
Write only declared height_difference_3 discovery outputs and never alter source LIDAR, HMLR or another slot.
Discovery output may contain transformed points and catalogue candidates only; numeric elevation remains null until boundary, raster and sampling contracts pass.
